exports.install_host(app, settings): Install after all API/WS/DAV/upload/domain routers. frontend_root is the frontend tree, not public. Registers final GET/HEAD dispatch with an explicit Vue-route whitelist and read-only static root.
exports.render_template(name, context, request=N: Returns HTMLResponse. Accepts main, desktop, download, report, email/unread (or email.unread), ie, and optional .html suffix. Business data is required; StrictUndefined rejects omissions. Supplying request creates/reuses signed CSRF cookie. Without request desktop/download callers must provide csrf_token. For email string use response.body.decode('utf-8').
exports.verify_csrf(request, secret, token=None): Boolean check of explicit form token or X-CSRF-TOKEN against authenticated CSRF cookie; never authentication and never automatically imposed on source-exempt token APIs.

required_settings_bindings.frontend_root: Path to copied frontend tree; reads public/manifest.json and serves only public assets.
required_settings_bindings.system_alias: IndexController.php:77 -> Base::settingFind('system', 'system_alias', 'WebPage'); main.blade.php:12,25 title. Parent supplies actual new-system configuration, not a host constant.
required_settings_bindings.login_logo: IndexController.php:78 -> Base::fillUrl(Base::settingFind('system', 'login_logo')); main.blade.php:26 loginLogo. Host expands nonempty relative values using request.base_url, leaves original absolute/root-relative/data:image values intact.
required_settings_bindings.debug: main.blade.php:27 -> config('app.debug'), config/app.php:42 -> APP_DEBUG; emitted as literal string yes/no. Host does not turn debug on to bypass encryption.
required_settings_bindings.version: IndexController.php:79 -> Base::getVersion(), Base.php:117-120 -> package version. Parent supplies actual application/version metadata.
required_settings_bindings.locale: main.blade.php:2 -> app()->getLocale(); config/app.php:83 default en. Parent supplies configured locale.
required_settings_bindings.csrf_secret: Required new-environment CSRF_SECRET, at least 32 characters, no embedded/default secret. This is a new signed-cookie session mechanism, not compatibility with old Laravel cookies.

main_template_contract.entry: manifest['resources/assets/js/app.js']['file'] and ['css'][0]; startup requires both to be valid contained existing files
main_template_contract.escaping: Jinja autoescape for HTML attributes/text; tojson for all dynamic script literals, including download postMessage URL; URL filter rejects executable schemes and control characters.

attributes: Secure when request scheme is HTTPS
csrf_contract.injected_token: nonce only, identical in meta and window.csrfToken
csrf_contract.validation: Strict hex/length and constant-time signature/token comparison; invalid cookie is replaced during rendering; HTML no-store.
csrf_contract.source_exemptions: bootstrap/app.php:33-41 exempts api/*, dav, dav/*, desktop/publish/. Parent API authenticates explicit token header/input rather than cookies.

routing.vue: All concrete routes.js parent/child routes and optional parameter arities, including project/invite, file, meeting/sharekey, single file/task/dialog/apps/email/report and all setting children; trailing slash and case-insensitive matching. Source /main alias retained.
routing.special_reason: Requires real avatar rasterizer/cache, desktop upload/release storage and publish auth, attachment/preview service, external icon service, or scheduled jobs; no fake data, service or SPA fallback. Real future domain routers may register before host.
routing.static_behavior: Starlette StaticFiles html=False and follow_symlink=False provides canonical containment, FileResponse MIME, conditional GET and ranges. Missing files/directories return 404, never HTML200. Source/config/PHP/private extensions, hidden components, traversal, Windows ADS/backslashes and residual percent escapes rejected; manifest/hot/source trees are not public URLs. Uploads/API/WS/DAV are not static-host mounts.
intentional_safety_differences: No arbitrary IndexController method dispatch or catch-all SPA success
Raw report/email strings autoescaped unless explicitly Markup

secondary_templates.structure: Original source HTML/CSS/JS preserved while replacing PHP/Blade directives with Jinja. No PHP execution.
secondary_templates.trusted_html: Report cell and email preview HTML is rendered verbatim only when a real business producer explicitly supplies markupsafe.Markup for generated/sanitized content; ordinary user strings remain escaped. Nullable userInfo keeps source null-safe avatar/nickname behavior.
